decisions.reason: BOM approval and authorization to order components do not change the system-layout deliverable.
The source approves the BOM for ordering but does not change the required wiring-plan detail or electrical-layout documentation.
General BOM approval does not explicitly or necessarily change the existing stainless-steel food-contact material requirements.
Authorization to order the approved BOM does not modify the splash-control targets, speed condition, or mitigation options.
The BOM ordering decision does not change the required structural support or operational stability behavior.
The client proceeds after the compatibility claim, but the source does not alter the compatibility acceptance condition or add a distinct product-state fact.
BOM approval does not change the required power headroom or simultaneous-load conditions; it only authorizes ordering of the selected components.
